items.title: Eldrew Yulo continues to prove boundless potential with Asian Games bronze
items.description: After his older brother Carlos captured back-to-back golds in floor exercise and vault, Eldrew Yulo also shines in his first Asian Games stint as he bags the bronze in horizontal bar

items.title: Mary Jane Veloso finally free after 16 years
items.description: Veloso, who was sentenced to death in Indonesia in 2010 for drug trafficking, is given absolute pardon by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

items.title: Gilas Women fall short of Asian Games 3×3 gold vs hot-shooting Japan
items.description: Kacey dela Rosa puts Gilas Women on her back, but Japan proves too much to handle, pulling away for the convincing win behind its hot shooting to deal the Philippines its only loss in the Asian Games

items.title: Marcos suspends excise taxes on LPG, kerosene anew
items.description: The tax relief does not extend to gasoline and diesel, as Finance Secretary Frederick Go says this would 'not be progressive' because higher-income consumers who use more of the two fuels would capture more of the benefit

items.title: Mary Jane Veloso’s counsel expects faster release after Marcos’ ‘unique’ absolute pardon
items.description: Veloso's lawyer explained that unlike their other clients who were released due to dismissal of cases or acquittal, Veloso’s case is the first time that the President itself had ordered the release.

items.title: Is Vince Dizon still in — or out — as DPWH chief?
items.description: 'Overdue na po kayo ng ilang araw,' Senator Imee Marcos tells DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon

items.title: SC asked to void lowered vote threshold in Sara Duterte impeachment
items.description: Two petitions have been filed before the Supreme Court challenging the lowered voting threshold approved by the Senate impeachment court to convict Vice President Sara Duterte.

items.title: Carlos Yulo falls short of parallel bars medal, concludes stellar Asian Games
items.description: Carlos Yulo narrowly misses out on a parallel bars bronze that would have been the cherry on top of his superb Asian Games run that saw him win back-to-back gold medals in floor exercise and vault

items.title: TIMELINE: Mary Jane Veloso’s case and road to freedom
items.description: The pardon granted to Mary Jane Veloso marks the end of a nearly two-decade ordeal that has spanned three presidents and years on death row

items.title: Culinary school, offices shut over alleged unlicensed Australia recruitment
items.description: Applicants without experience were allegedly charged P420,000, including about P270,000 for a 12-month culinary program.

items.title: Padilla appears at DOJ, yet to answer obstruction rap over Dela Rosa's escape
items.description: Padilla and his co-respondents have yet to submit their counter-affidavits.

items.title: Meet the new cornerstone investors lining up for GCash’s record IPO
items.description: From the world's biggest asset manager to the World Bank's private sector investment arm, GCash has already secured about P36.5 billion in cornerstone commitments ahead of its October 6-12 IPO offer period

items.title: Here’s PhilHealth timeline for expected benefit expansion until 2028
items.description: PhilHealth is seeking from lawmakers an additional P170 billion for 2027 to fully implement its benefit expansion, as well as cover projected insurance claims of indirect contributors

items.title: Carlos Yulo redeems self, vaults to another Asian Games gold
items.description: After barely qualifying for the finals, Carlos Yulo captures a second artistic gymnastics gold medal for the Philippines in the 2026 Asian Games as he rules the men’s vault

items.title: Ban on Discord, Reddit lifted after safety compliance
items.description: The two platforms reportedly became inaccessible to some users earlier this week after Philippine authorities gave them a 24-hour ultimatum to establish their presence in the country.

items.title: Trillanes sought as witness on Duterte wealth allegations
items.description: They want him questioned over alleged P181.6-M transactions involving Sara Duterte and her family.

items.title: Marcos signs law postponing 2026 barangay, SK elections
items.description: The newly approved law moved the elections to the first Monday of November 2028, and extended the terms of village officers from four to five years.

items.title: Marcos grants absolute pardon to Mary Jane Veloso
items.description: This is after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed an executive clemency for Veloso, giving her a clean slate.

items.title: DOE sees P8 diesel price rollback by end-September
items.description: The P8 per liter rollback on diesel, P6 on kerosene and P0.90 in gasoline, are expected next week.

items.title: ‘Queenie’ maintains strength, may become typhoon by Sunday
items.description: Tropical Storm Queenie maintained its strength as it moved northwestward over the Philippine Sea, PAGASA said Friday morning.
